params.prompt: Create a NEW professional photographic portrait of the exact same real adult man shown in all three attached original interview frames. They show one person with different expressions. Treat them as identity references, not a style reference. Preserve his facial proportions, face width, natural cheeks, eyes and their real asymmetry, brow shape, nose, lips, ears, natural skin tone, age and black cornrow braids pulled back. Do not beautify into a different person, slim his jaw, enlarge the eyes, make both eyelids symmetrical, change his age, invent moles, or add muscle. Keep a calm closed-mouth expression as in the originals; do not invent a toothy smile. The FIRST reference shows his face at rest and the other two clarify his identity. Remove the old interview background, sports jacket, lettering and lanyard. Realistic directional studio light with a real gentle shadow, skin pores, fine facial hair, realistic fabric, no airbrushed wax skin, no halos, no text, no watermark, no logos, no fake borders. Leave natural breathing room above his hair and show both shoulders. This is a new portrait composition, not an identity replacement. A bright understated studio with a soft off-white-grey background. Wear a charcoal tailored blazer over a plain white cotton crew-neck t-shirt, no tie and no accessories. Seated relaxed, three-quarter torso with face facing camera, upper-body portrait from just above the waist. Hands are outside the frame. Soft daylight from camera left, credible natural business headshot with real skin and jacket fabric, 85mm lens.
